flavorPatch: The forest answers every prayer with a thousand seedlings.
Rage is a season; it blooms and burns in a single turn.
Nature does not negotiate. It reclaims.
Growth is the only ledger the wild keeps.
Instinct needs no teacher; the woods provide the lesson.
The mycelium remembers every footfall. It collects.
A harvest sown in patience, reaped in armies.
Roots know the way; the traveler need only follow.
Old timber snaps loudest when the wind turns.
Wildfire does not ask permission to bloom.
The canopy crashes down; the forest floor rises.
Even iron rusts when the vines decide it's time.
The vine does not chase; it waits where the path must cross.
Every fruit carries a seed; every seed, a map.
Thorns strike where the bark is thinnest.
Roots rise where the foot falls heaviest.
The stampede answers the call before the horn sounds.
Growth is not gentle. It is inevitable.
The forest speaks in falling timber.
The beast does not wait for an invitation.
Resolve is a seed; the harvest is certainty.
A touch that lingers long after the hand withdraws.
Life is a debt; death collects with interest.
The wind carries no names, only endings.
Blood waters the roots of forbidden knowledge.
The pact is signed in silence; the witness is dust.
Decay is patient. It always wins the long game.
A touch that turns vigor to rot in a heartbeat.
The lantern drinks what the living spill.
The smallest push topples the tallest corpse.
